dossier.aide:
How to find this folder
  1. In Steam, right-click Le Mans Ultimate, then Manage › Browse local files.
  2. In the window that opens, go into UserData, then into Telemetry.
  3. Click the address bar at the top of the window, copy the path (Ctrl+C) and paste it above (Ctrl+V).

The Telemetry folder only appears after your first session: if you don't have it yet, drive a few laps and come back.

regularite.analyse: Analysing every lap of the session…
regularite.note_ideal: The ideal lap strings together your best run through every corner: {marge} s under your best lap, without improving anything, just by repeating what you have already done.
regularite.note_course: ⚠ Race session: traffic, strategy and flags weigh on the lap times without saying anything about your driving.
regularite.note_peu_de_tours: ⚠ Only {n} laps: the spreads below are only indicative. You would need at least five to rely on them.
regularite.pas_de_derive: Your lap times are not drifting: the fitted line is flat.
regularite.derive_accelere: {valeur} s per lap — on average, you get faster over the session.
regularite.derive_ralentit: {valeur} s per lap — on average, you get slower over the session.
regularite.description: This is a description, not an explanation: tyre wear, falling fuel load and learning all mix together.
regularite.passage_isole: one isolated pass weighs heavily (lap {n}) — an incident, not inconsistency
comparaison.incoherent: ⚠ the delta does not end on the lap time difference
comparaison.aide_zoom: Drag across a chart or use the mouse wheel to zoom · double-click to go back
graphe.delta: Cumulative delta — the compared lap loses time where the curve rises
piste.note: Measured width {largeur} m on average. Each edge is drawn solid where one of the two laps ran along it, dashed elsewhere — there it is estimated from its measurements before and after.
virages.entete: {n} corners, detected from the track curvature. “Time lost” spreads the lap gap over the corners: every metre counts for exactly one corner, so the column adds up to the final gap. The boundary is set halfway along each straight. Coasting, neither brake nor throttle: {ref} s for the reference against {cmp} s for the compared lap. Click a row to zoom the charts onto it. Editable corner map: {fichier}
virages.zoomer: Zoom the charts onto this corner
serveur.tour.incoherent: measured time {ecart} s longer than the lap time — lap not comparable (race start)
serveur.tour.quasi_arret: near stop on track ({vitesse} km/h for {duree} s)
serveur.virage.pas_de_remise_gaz: not back on the throttle before the end of the zone
serveur.avert.voitures: The two laps are not in the same car ({ref} vs {cmp}). The delta then mostly measures a difference in machinery, not in driving.
serveur.avert.arret_reference: The reference lap ({n}) nearly stopped ({vitesse} km/h for {duree} s). The delta will jump vertically at that point: the distance stops moving while the time keeps running.
serveur.avert.arret_compare: The compared lap ({n}) nearly stopped ({vitesse} km/h for {duree} s). The delta will jump vertically at that point: the distance stops moving while the time keeps running.
